title: 1981 show home with a crane-lifted floor hits the market
summary_full: A three-bedroom house known as ‘Topper’ is available for sale in Milton Keynes at an asking price of £500,000. It was built using innovative methods during the Homeworld ’81 housing exhibition that showcased new construction techniques. The property offers 1,302 square feet of living space, including three bedrooms and three reception rooms. Its current owners have maintained the house for over 30 years, planning to relocate.
